title: Enable automatic payment methods on PaymentIntents
summary: Stripe can now choose which payment methods to offer for each PaymentIntent based on your Dashboard settings, currency and the customer's location. Opt in by passing automatic_payment_methods: { enabled: true } when you create a PaymentIntent.
migrationSteps: Add automatic_payment_methods: { enabled: true } to every stripe.paymentIntents.create(...) call.
Do not combine it with payment_method_types; remove payment_method_types if present.
Leave the rest of the PaymentIntent parameters and the confirmation flow unchanged.
